note: Guardrail canaries (D-057): synthetic, known-bad probes an SDK passes to the app's own guardrail check, so the evidence shows the guardrail catching something rather than only being configured. The probes are made up (the card number is a published test number, the key is AWS's documented example), stay in the app, and are never exported; only the kind and whether it was caught are. Every SDK embeds exactly these probes; its tests compare them with this file.
